##Slide
This move has been around for ages but is no longer the most common one. Some professionals (such as [Yeonwoo Cho in 2019](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BUetCMEW4Cc&t=53) and [Michael Redmond in 2020](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MzglC0kVQTY&t=142s)) have noted a decrease in the AI winning percentage once played and called it slightly bad. True enough, this slide has little effect on Black, who needn't respond locally. But modern AI doesn't entirely shun it. In fact, it's occasionally the preferred move of modern AI such as Tencent's FineArt. It can be recommended when taking sente isn't so important and for double-digit kyu players because it's simple. Otherwise, attaching may be preferred, as in <position: 16045>.
